title: Flavors of Philly Food Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Vegetarian option is available, please advise at time of booking if required
Children age 0-2 are free but will not receive food unless a ticket is purchased
This tour cannot accommodate a gluten-free diet. Contact us before booking with questions.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: The Flavors of Philly Tour is great for out-of-towners! Terrific value--Philly history AND full lunch rolled into one great adventure. Features cheesesteaks, tomato pie, soft pretzels, and 2 desserts at the iconic Reading Terminal Market.
